metadata.title: Is the AI Capex Bubble About to Burst? What 250 Years of Market History Tell Us.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Is the AI Capex Bubble About to Burst? What 250 Years of Market History Tell Us.
The spending on artificial intelligence will end, but probably not when investors suspect it will.
When it comes to a capital spending bubble, the trick isn’t dancing when the music is playing, but knowing when it’s time to sit down. As summer turns to fall, investors should keep on dancing to the AI beat.
